scopedRequirementDetails.summary: Blueprint graph and packet transport supplied by the host's Membrane/Blueprint service. Audit can optionally consume host-supplied legion-graph/1 JSON through LEGION_AUDIT_GRAPH_ARTIFACT, retaining a labelled lexical floor when absent or rejected.
scopedRequirementDetails.degradation: For Blueprint requests, use the bounded host one-shot or return NO_CAPABILITY naming blueprint-graph; never present ungraphed results as graph results. Audit optional artifact consumption retains explicitly labelled lexical import leads when absent or rejected, with no call-graph or dead-code proof.
scopedRequirementDetails.remedy: Provide Blueprint transport through Membrane or put the host's `blueprint` executable on PATH. For Audit artifact consumption, set LEGION_AUDIT_GRAPH_ARTIFACT to an absolute JSON file in a host-owned directory outside audited source and snapshot roots; the consumer checks source/resolver bindings but does not authenticate the producer. This package does not ship a graph engine.

bundles.description: Use only for explicit `/session` compatibility modes: status, init, brief, context-hygiene, or file-search.

hostRequirementDetails.degradation: The legion MCP server fails to start and legion_m1_invoke/legion_m1_status are absent from the tool list. Skills that shell out to `legion` must treat it as unavailable, never as returning an empty result.
hostRequirementDetails.remedy: Install the Legion native release so `legion` is on PATH, or run against a host that provides it.

bundles.name: social
bundles.description: Route Instagram, Pinterest, YouTube, Twitter or X, LinkedIn, Reels, Shorts, pins, threads, calendars, distribution, analytics, and social growth. Use /social or when social strategy or content is the deliverable.

hostRequirementDetails.degradation: Research returns UNPROVEN for any claim that required live retrieval.
hostRequirementDetails.remedy: Expose a web-search tool in the host; Research blocks rather than guessing.

hostRequirementDetails.degradation: Skip the media step and state that it was skipped.
hostRequirementDetails.remedy: Wire a video/rich-media generation tool into the host. This package ships no media generator.

bundles.name: tasklist
bundles.description: Create executable same-agent task lists, implementation plans, execution preflights, or automation plans. Use `/tasklist`; keep ordinary work inline. Use Dispatch for another agent & Handoff for a new chat.

hostRequirementDetails.degradation: The legion MCP server fails to start and legion_m1_invoke/legion_m1_status are absent from the tool list. Skills that shell out to `legion` must treat it as unavailable, never as returning an empty result.
hostRequirementDetails.remedy: Install the Legion native release so `legion` is on PATH, or run against a host that provides it.

hostRequirementDetails.degradation: Architect states that no ownership index is available and designs without it, recording each build-new decision as unverified against shared owners.
hostRequirementDetails.remedy: Install RightKit so `rightkit owns --compact` is on PATH.

bundles.name: wake
bundles.description: Request one bounded wakeup for an active job, external review, or goal-alignment check, only where the host exposes a scheduler or event wait; inspect once per wake, stop polling, & continue only from observed state.

bundles.name: watchdog
bundles.description: Invoke Legion Sentry for explicitly requested recurring supervision or a due watchdog checkpoint using independent host scheduling and read-only Oracle review.

hostRequirementDetails.degradation: Report UNSCHEDULED when no existing scheduler can fire outside the supervised executor chat. Do not emulate recurrence with a separate chat, subagent, executor heartbeat, sleep, or polling.
hostRequirementDetails.remedy: Expose an existing host scheduler that can fire independently of the supervised executor chat; Legion ships no scheduler.

bundles.name: writing
bundles.description: Draft, rewrite, or edit any prose a reader will receive: emails, internal updates and announcements, newsletters, scripts, captions, posts, documentation, proposals, specs, FAQs, blog and SEO copy, bios, DMs, product copy, and changelogs. Load before drafting: it applies the skill's voice and anti-filler checks. Use whenever words are the deliverable, even short ones.
